13:     _cdist_ctw,
14:     _cdist_soft_dtw,
15:     _cdist_sax,
16:     _cdist_frechet,
17:     TSLEARN_VALID_METRICS
18: )
19: from tslearn.piecewise import SymbolicAggregateApproximation
20: from tslearn.utils import (
21:     to_time_series_dataset,
22:     to_sklearn_dataset,
23:     check_array,
24:     check_dims
25: )
26: 
27: 
28: class KNeighborsTimeSeriesMixin(TimeSeriesMixin):
29:     """Mixin for k-neighbors searches on Time Series."""
30: 
31:     def _sax_preprocess(self, X, n_segments=10, alphabet_size_avg=4,
32:                         scale=False):
33:         # Now SAX-transform the time series
34:         if not hasattr(self, '_sax') or self._sax is None:
35:             self._sax = SymbolicAggregateApproximation(
36:                 n_segments=n_segments,
37:                 alphabet_size_avg=alphabet_size_avg,
38:                 scale=scale
39:             )
40:         X_sax = self._sax.fit_transform(X)
41: 
42:         return X_sax
43: 
44:     def _get_metric_params(self):
45:         if self.metric_params is None:
46:             metric_params = {}
47:         else:
48:             metric_params = self.metric_params.copy()
49:         if "gamma_sdtw" in metric_params.keys():
50:             metric_params["gamma"] = metric_params["gamma_sdtw"]
51:             del metric_params["gamma_sdtw"]
52:         if "n_jobs" in metric_params.keys():
53:             del metric_params["n_jobs"]
54:         if "verbose" in metric_params.keys():
55:             del metric_params["verbose"]
56:         return metric_params
57: 
58:     def _precompute_cross_dist(self, X, other_X=None):
59:         if other_X is None:
60:             other_X = self._ts_fit
61: 
62:         self._ts_metric = self.metric
63:         self.metric = "precomputed"
64: 
65:         metric_params = self._get_metric_params()
66: 
67:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
68:         X = to_time_series_dataset(X)
69: 
70:         if self._ts_metric == "dtw":
71:             X_ = _cdist_dtw(
72:                 X,
73:                 other_X,
74:                 n_jobs=self.n_jobs,
75:                 **metric_params)
76:         elif self._ts_metric == "ctw":
77:             X_ = _cdist_ctw(X, other_X, **metric_params)
78:         elif self._ts_metric == "softdtw":
79:             X_ = _cdist_soft_dtw(X, other_X, **metric_params)
80:         elif self._ts_metric == "sax":
81:             X = self._sax_preprocess(X, **metric_params)
82:             X_ = _cdist_sax(
83:                 X,
84:                 self._sax.breakpoints_avg_,
85:                 self._sax._X_fit_dims_[1],
86:                 other_X,
87:                 n_jobs=self.n_jobs)
88:         elif self._ts_metric == "frechet":
89:             X_ = _cdist_frechet(
90:                 X,
91:                 other_X,
92:                 n_jobs=self.n_jobs,
93:                 **metric_params
94:             )
95:         else:
96:             raise ValueError("Invalid metric recorded: %s" %
97:                              self._ts_metric)
98: 
99:         return X_
100: 
101:     def kneighbors(self, X=None, n_neighbors=None, return_distance=True):
102:         """Finds the K-neighbors of a point.
103: 
104:         Returns indices of and distances to the neighbors of each point.
105: 
106:         Parameters
107:         ----------
108:         X : array-like, shape (n_ts, sz, d)
109:             The query time series.
110:             If not provided, neighbors of each indexed point are returned.
111:             In this case, the query point is not considered its own neighbor.
112:         n_neighbors : int
113:             Number of neighbors to get (default is the value passed to the
114:             constructor).
115:         return_distance : boolean, optional. Defaults to True.
116:             If False, distances will not be returned
117: 
118:         Returns
119:         -------
120:         dist : array
121:             Array representing the distance to points, only present if
122:             return_distance=True
123:         ind : array
124:             Indices of the nearest points in the population matrix.
125:         """
126:         self_neighbors = False
127:         if n_neighbors is None:
128:             n_neighbors = self.n_neighbors
129:         if X is None:
130:             X = self._X_fit
131:             self_neighbors = True
132:         if self.metric == "precomputed":
133:             full_dist_matrix = X
134:         else:
135: 
136:             if X.ndim == 2:  # sklearn-format case
137:                 X = X.reshape((X.shape[0], -1, self._d))
138:                 fit_X = self._X_fit.reshape((self._X_fit.shape[0],
139:                                              -1,
140:                                              self._d))
141:             elif hasattr(self, '_ts_fit') and self._ts_fit is not None:
142:                 fit_X = self._ts_fit
143:             else:
144:                 fit_X = self._X_fit
145: 
146:             if self.metric in TSLEARN_VALID_METRICS:
147:                 full_dist_matrix = self._precompute_cross_dist(X,
148:                                                                other_X=fit_X)
149:             elif self.metric in ["euclidean", "sqeuclidean", "cityblock"]:
150:                 full_dist_matrix = scipy_cdist(X.reshape((X.shape[0], -1)),
151:                                                fit_X.reshape((fit_X.shape[0],
152:                                                               -1)),
153:                                                metric=self.metric)
154:             else:
155:                 raise ValueError("Unrecognized time series metric string: %s "
156:                                  "(should be one of 'dtw', 'softdtw', "
157:                                  "'frechet', 'sax', 'euclidean', 'sqeuclidean'"
158:                                  " or 'cityblock')" % self.metric)
159: 
160:         # Code similar to sklearn (sklearn/neighbors/base.py), to make sure
161:         # that TimeSeriesKNeighbor~(metric='euclidean') has the same results as
162:         # feeding a distance matrix to sklearn.KNeighbors~(metric='euclidean')
163:         kbin = min(n_neighbors - 1, full_dist_matrix.shape[1] - 1)
164:         # argpartition will make sure the first `kbin` entries are the
165:         # `kbin` smallest ones (but in arbitrary order) --> complexity: O(n)
166:         ind = numpy.argpartition(full_dist_matrix, kbin, axis=1)
167: 
168:         if self_neighbors:
